scale_cues: Large square white dinner plate (assumed ~26-28 cm across) filling most of the frame; corn cob slice (~4-5 cm diameter) used as a secondary size reference; fork tines partly visible at top left.
assumptions: Protein is assumed to be crusted chicken breast; it could be fish or another white meat with a grain/crumb coating
Scattered grains on the plate and in the greens are assumed to be cooked quinoa
Dark greens under the chicken are assumed to be sauteed kale or chard with a little oil
No visible dressing on the salad greens; assumed undressed
Corn mass counts kernels only, excluding the inedible cob core
Plate assumed to be a standard ~27 cm square dinner plate
